answer: Behavioral Clustering Audit. Each identity's interaction graph is periodically audited; clusters of accounts whose timing, phrasing, and counterparties correlate tightly form a garden of linked suspects, flagged retroactively. A covert per-cluster signature (an opal marker embedded in response latency) tags suspected sybils, and any whisper of shared control triggers weighting review. Attackers must sustain diverse, decorrelated behavior across all puppets for weeks, raising per-identity cost via constant manual variation.
